content:
Samir Kahn: Heads up 10AM: BeaconMed wants a short onsite airgap POC. Main asks: how we deliver signed runtime/model bundles, upgrade cadence (policy says monthly but they want emergency push path), support for customer-hosted HSM, and commercial line for sealed environment fees. They also attached a 30Q security questionnaire.

Priya Iyer: Quick clarifying points: 1) Do they require us to courier USBs or will an encrypted SD transfer to their staging jump box work? 2) Are they insisting we hold signing keys or do they want the option to sign locally after we provide tooling? 3) Max file size per minibundle?

Samir Kahn: They prefer we handle packaging for the POC to keep it simple. Transport: courier preferred but SD is acceptable if <300MB per minibundle. Long term they want the tooling to selfsign.

Oliver Stone: Technical take:
- We can produce notarized delta bundles with Notary V2 manifests and reproducible SBOMs.
- HSM: we support BYO-HSM for Private; for airgap we either provide signing artifacts to be loaded into their HSM via secure courier or integrate with an onprem KMIP endpoint if they can expose it to our deployment window.
- Hotfixes: emergency CVE pushes require offline hotfix bundle + signed patch deliverable. We can commit to a 4872h turnaround for critical CVEs under an SLA addendum.
- ETA: staging POC artifacts in ~2 weeks if requirements locked today, +35 days for customer HSM onboarding.

Oliver Stone: sample manifest fragment they can validate:```
bundle: beacon-poc-2026-04
parts:
  - runtime.tgz
  - model.delta
size: 209_734_880
signature: sha256:abc123...
notary_ref: sha256:def456...
```

Rina Cho: Security notes:
- Default telemetry off. Any telemetry must be explicit and optionally allow offline collection by their SIEM.
- We will produce an SBOM and attestation per minibundle; can include a signed build log for audit.
- Pen testing: we allow scoped 3rdparty pentests on the POC with an NDA and agreed test window.
- Retention: confirm if they need longterm archive (we can store manifests for 5 years by default, extendable).

Marta (Solutions): Commercial sketch:
- Oneoff POC packaging & signing setup: $9,500 (includes custom manifests, SBOM automation, initial notarization).
- POC support (2 week engagement): $3,200 (eng + solutions).
- Emergency hotfix addendum (SLA guaranteed response): $4,000 flat for the POC period.
- Ongoing sealedenvironment maintenance: $2,000/month (includes up to 2 signed deltas/month and archive).
- If we handle onprem HSM key custody or physical courier logistics, add $5,500 onetime.
Pricing provisional until we confirm transport method and retention requirements.

Samir Kahn: Can someone draft a concise SOW and a checklist for the SQ items? Also need a simple onepage explanation on the Notary verification flow for the customer's infra/security team.

Priya Iyer: I'll assemble the SOW skeleton and a security checklist. Checklist items I need from BeaconMed:
- Transport preference (courier vs encrypted SD)
- Max minibundle size they can accept via logistics
- Decision on signing: our sign vs selfsign tool acceptance
- Contact for their security/infrastructure lead for pen test coordination
- Retention period for signed bundles/manifests

Rina Cho: Add whether they require reproducible builds and whether they will require signed SBOMs per release. Also clarify if they want our telemetry validator to run in a passive-only mode.

Oliver Stone: If they confirm courier + our signing for POC and no custom runtime patches during build window, hitting the 2week artifact ETA is realistic.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled "BeaconMed airgap POC kickoff" Apr 9 09:00 PT. Invites sent. :calendar:

Samir Kahn: Thanks team. I'll ping BeaconMed and post their SQ replies here when I have them. :thumbsup:
